scope: Supervisor unit: the shipped unit is rendered for this installation (paths, service user and Bun directory), verified with systemd-analyze, and the exact install commands are recorded. With --apply and root the unit is installed, reloaded, enabled and started, and the run fails unless it becomes active. Not a substitute for the server acceptance run, which requires the unit to be installed.
rendered:
[Unit]
Description=sbarbase installation supervisor (owned Supabase placement, console and worker)
Documentation=file:/home/sbarah/R/Projects/P/sbarbase/docs/SERVER-DEPLOYMENT.md
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=sbarbase
Group=sbarbase
WorkingDirectory=/home/sbarah/R/Projects/P/sbarbase
Environment=HOME=/home/sbarbase
# A system service does not inherit a user-local Bun; the supervisor and its
# preflight both need it on PATH.
Environment=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin:/home/sbarah/.bun/bin
# Preflight refuses on insufficient headroom, missing pins or pending authority state.
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/python3 /home/sbarah/R/Projects/P/sbarbase/lab/install_server.py check
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /home/sbarah/R/Projects/P/sbarbase/lab/dev.py
# dev.py stops the owned runtime on SIGTERM; allow its 90 second budget.
TimeoutStopSec=150
KillMode=mixed
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
# The supervisor needs Docker access; keep it out of the docker group only if an
# equivalent socket permission already applies to this user.
SupplementaryGroups=docker
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=full
ReadWritePaths=/home/sbarah/R/Projects/P/sbarbase /home/sbarbase/.secrets

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
